column1: # Kabar Javanese frequency list. Generated by `kabar-tools freq jv`; do not edit by hand
# (add junk to jv.exclude.tsv instead). Sources (see ATTRIBUTION.md):
#   nusa: NusaWrites (NusaAlinea paragraphs + NusaKalimat, written by native speakers) and NusaX
#         sentiment, Javanese parts, IndoNLP (Cahyawijaya, Winata et al.)
#   jvwiki: Javanese Wikipedia articles (CC BY-SA 4.0), added when the dump is fetched on the Mac.
# Caveat: everyday written Javanese, mostly ngoko; krama words rank lower than in polite speech.
# This derived list is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.
# Columns: rank, word, zipf (log10 per billion words), sources that list the word.
